title: I made a game entirely with AI in honor of George Floyd
author: Valuable_Manner6417
selftext:
I made a game entirely using AI in remembrance of George Floyd. You click to build a community, unlock kind words, and spread positive messages.

Here's a video showcasing the game.

comments.author: Significant-Neck-520
comments.body: I find this of bad taste. The point of the protests was not that he was a good man, but there there was systemic police brutality that should be addressed.

replies.author: Valuable_Manner6417
replies.body: I understand that, and I agree that the protests were about addressing systemic police brutality. My intention with the game isn't to make a statement about anyone being a perfect person, but to create something centered around community, kind words, and remembrance using AI.

replies.author: Significant-Neck-520
replies.body: Ah, ok, I thought you were mocking the situation, sorry

replies.author: ponderdiggums
replies.body: I think you read the situation correctly, tbh.

comments.author: Afraid-Molasses1103
comments.body: So you get more points by clicking his neck? Amazing.
